scenes.learningTarget: DelBene was appointed to the bipartisan Select Committee on the Modernization of Congress on January 29, 2019.

opening.ko: 1월 29일 제가 임명된 초당적 특별위원회를 찾아 보세요. 농업이나 법원 문제를 다루는 상임위원회와는 다릅니다.

correct.speaker: npc:0

correct.en: Modernization of Congress. Frame the issue as improving how Congress itself works.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0

incorrect.en: I was appointed to the Select Committee on the Modernization of Congress. The focus here is Congress's own operations.

evidence.claim: Appointed Jan 29, 2019 to bipartisan Select Committee on Modernization of Congress.
